name: Polymarket BTC settlement-anchor state
description: Consumes the resolving Chainlink BTC/USD 60-second TWAP (the exact data Polymarket resolves on) and the bound market's rules card. anchor_price is the latest TWAP value; threshold is the contract reference level verbatim from the rules card. distance_bps = (anchor - threshold) / threshold in signed basis points. time_to_close_ms is the time remaining to the rules-card close; the update is not ready once the window is closed or an input is missing. side_if_settled_now applies the contract comparator to anchor versus threshold (an exact tie resolves per the contract's tie outcome). state is pinned when the absolute distance is at or within pin_threshold_bps AND time_to_close_ms is at or within pin_window_ms — the resolution-sensitivity context — and tracking otherwise. Not ready until both inputs are seen. Polymarket only: the Kalshi variant is deferred while its CF Benchmarks BRTI settlement path is rights-gated. Published under the bound market scope, so an unbound, still-warming or closed market fails it closed. observation_time is the decision instant the reading was evaluated at, which is also the instant time_to_close_ms is measured from. This contextualizes the anchor path; it does no probability or volatility modeling and predicts nothing. pin_threshold_bps defaults to 10 and pin_window_ms defaults to 60000. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. side_if_settled_now's void variant is reachable only through a rules card declaring tie_outcome void; the currently declared Polymarket rules-card vocabulary is up-only, so void is unreachable from the present surface and is retained for contract variants that declare it.
